notes: minMatchPercent - every recommendation at or above this is applied, always. dailyCap - target applications per day. When fewer than dailyCap qualify at minMatchPercent, the agent keeps going down the recommended list (match-sorted) and jobright search results for targetKeywords, but never below fillToCapMinPercent. preferJobrightApply - Jobright flow first, company site fallback.

radarFill.note: After the Jobright pool is cleared, fill the remaining daily quota from the AI Hiring Radar, best score first, per-tab resumes, browser worker submits with confirmation verification.

costNotes: Single 1:00am ET run. greenhousePerWindowCap is now per-run (one window/day): 45 keeps the old 3x15 daily Greenhouse total with 180s pacing (~2.3h worst case). Batch bookkeeping: commit/push every ~5 confirmations, one consolidated log line per job, one watcher per chunk.
